memory_action.body:
**Why:** Candidate 6 improved the mean to 11.59109. The fixed depot coefficients cancel, leaving only current distance minus a fill-weighted radial reward.

**How to apply:** Treat fill-weighted radial reward as the actual incumbent structure. Preserve it when testing a small orthogonal signal.

**Limitations:** Frozen six-instance CVRP development suite and current evaluator only.
